name: cv-wicked-campaigns
description: Build tooling for the Wicked Campaigns Foundry VTT module

scripts.unpack: npm run unpack:adventures && npm run unpack:rolltables && npm run unpack:macros && npm run unpack:lore && npm run unpack:characters
scripts.unpack:adventures: fvtt package unpack --id cv-wicked-campaigns --type Module -n wicked-adventures -t Adventure --in packs --out packs/_source/wicked-adventures --clean
scripts.unpack:rolltables: fvtt package unpack --id cv-wicked-campaigns --type Module -n wicked-roll-tables -t RollTable --in packs --out packs/_source/wicked-roll-tables --clean
scripts.unpack:macros: fvtt package unpack --id cv-wicked-campaigns --type Module -n wicked-macros -t Macro --in packs --out packs/_source/wicked-macros --clean
scripts.unpack:lore: fvtt package unpack --id cv-wicked-campaigns --type Module -n wicked-lore -t JournalEntry --in packs --out packs/_source/wicked-lore --clean
scripts.unpack:characters: fvtt package unpack --id cv-wicked-campaigns --type Module -n wicked-example-characters -t Actor --in packs --out packs/_source/wicked-example-characters --clean
scripts.pack: npm run pack:adventures && npm run pack:rolltables && npm run pack:macros && npm run pack:lore && npm run pack:characters
scripts.pack:adventures: fvtt package pack --id cv-wicked-campaigns --type Module -n wicked-adventures -t Adventure --in packs/_source/wicked-adventures --out packs
scripts.pack:rolltables: fvtt package pack --id cv-wicked-campaigns --type Module -n wicked-roll-tables -t RollTable --in packs/_source/wicked-roll-tables --out packs
scripts.pack:macros: fvtt package pack --id cv-wicked-campaigns --type Module -n wicked-macros -t Macro --in packs/_source/wicked-macros --out packs
scripts.pack:lore: fvtt package pack --id cv-wicked-campaigns --type Module -n wicked-lore -t JournalEntry --in packs/_source/wicked-lore --out packs
scripts.pack:characters: fvtt package pack --id cv-wicked-campaigns --type Module -n wicked-example-characters -t Actor --in packs/_source/wicked-example-characters --out packs
